			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_0 et-waypoint et_pb_animation_bottom et-animated  et_pb_text_align_center et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h1>Mazava Loha Resort</h1></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_1 et-waypoint et_pb_animation_bottom et-animated  et_pb_text_align_center et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h2>emerald sea | Madagascar</h2></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_button_module_wrapper et_pb_button_0_wrapper et_pb_button_alignment_center et_pb_module  dbdb-icon-on-right dbdb-icon-on-hover">
				<a id="bouton-landscape" class="et_pb_button et_pb_button_0 et_hover_enabled et_pb_bg_layout_light" href="#about">+</a>
			</div>
			</div>
			</div>
			</div><div id="about" class="et_pb_section et_pb_section_4 et_section_regular" >
				<div class="et_pb_row et_pb_row_3">
				<div class="et_pb_column et_pb_column_4_4 et_pb_column_7  et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough et-last-child">
				<div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_2 et_animated  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h2>A unique experience</h2></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_divider_0 et_animated et_pb_space et_pb_divider_hidden"><div class="et_pb_divider_internal"></div></div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_3 et_animated  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p style="text-align: center;">Ideally situated in front of the renowned kitesurf and windsurf spot of Babaomby, in the heart of the stunning Emerald Sea in northern Madagascar, Mazava Loha Resort offers exceptionally comfortable accommodation. Our wooden bungalows, nestled in the lush forest, and our suites with breathtaking sea views promise an unforgettable experience.</p></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_4 et_animated  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p style="text-align: center;">After a decade of exploration, sailing, and marveling at the wonders of the Emerald Sea, our passion has materialized in Mazava Loha Resort, a sanctuary of hospitality and gastronomy designed to reflect the extraordinary splendor of this exceptional place. Nestled by the sea, facing the legendary pool spot, our resort offers an incomparable experience for kitesurf, windsurf, and foil enthusiasts, while also captivating travelers, couples, and families seeking relaxation, change of scenery, and wonder. Every detail, from the wooden bungalows in the heart of a lush forest to suites offering stunning sea views, has been meticulously thought out to create a one-of-a-kind place. Our commitment to excellence is also evident in our gastronomic offerings, blending local and international flavors. Book your stay at Mazava Loha Resort, where elegance meets adventure, and every moment becomes a celebration of the natural splendor of the Emerald Sea.</p></div>
			</div>
			</div>
			</div>
			</div><div id="kite" class="et_pb_section et_pb_section_5 et_pb_section_parallax et_section_regular" >
				<div class="et_pb_row et_pb_row_4">

				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p>Optimal wind statistics for exceptional navigation, various spots for initiation, free-ride, freestyle, big air, and waves.</p>
<p>+</p>
<p>Sea excursions to explore the islands and beaches of the Emerald Sea, hikes, and on-land activities for the whole family.</p>
<p>+</p>
<p>A palette of water colors unique in the world!</p></div>
